name: Traditional Lime-Surkhi Pozzolanic Mortar (Chuna-Surkhi)
traditional_use: Primary conservation intervention mortar, joint repointing, and hydraulic render for traditional Indian water heritage.

moisture_behavior.capillary_suction: Controlled microporosity preventing rapid capillary water uptake
moisture_behavior.drying_rate: Rapid drying ensures dampness escapes outwards without building internal pore hydrostatic pressure
moisture_behavior.summary: Acts as the preferential evaporation path, protecting adjacent stone blocks from moisture entrapment and sub-florescence.

mechanical_characteristics.stiffness: Low modulus of elasticity (2.0-4.5 GPa), significantly lower than historic stone
mechanical_characteristics.ductility: High plastic deformation capacity, absorbs structural settlement and thermal expansion
mechanical_characteristics.sacrificial_behavior: Strictly sacrificial: relieves stress by microscopic internal deformation rather than splitting the host stone
mechanical_characteristics.summary: Guarantees that joint mortar yields first before historic stone units suffer edge fractures or spalling.

thermal_characteristics.thermal_shock_resilience: High compatibility with extreme diurnal heat cycles (0°C to 48°C)
thermal_characteristics.compatibility_with_historic_stones: Thermal dilation matches sandstone, quartzite, and brickwork
thermal_characteristics.summary: Eliminates shear stress at the interface during daytime solar heating and nocturnal desert cooling.

chemical_considerations.soluble_salts_risk: Zero deleterious sulfate or alkali salt introduction
chemical_considerations.reactivity_with_limestone: Pozzolanic reaction forms amorphous calcium silicate hydrates (C-S-H) that resist water dissolution
chemical_considerations.summary: Hydraulically stable under continuous water contact; free of alkali-silica reactivity (ASR).

reversibility.extraction_method: Gentle manual raking or vibration-free micro-chisel without abrasion of host stone arrises
reversibility.retreatability: Fully retreatable; historical masonry remains intact upon removal

heritage_compatibility.iks_alignment: Exemplary indigenous formulation leveraging under-fired calcined clay (surkhi) and organic herbal slaking binders
heritage_compatibility.asi_intach_compliance: Primary mortar recommended by ASI and INTACH guidelines for stone masonry repointing
heritage_compatibility.authenticity_status: Historically and culturally authentic intervention material

limitations: Requires proper Pozzolanic reactivity testing of surkhi aggregate (lime reactivity > 4.0 MPa per IS 1344).
Requires careful 21-day moist-jute curing to attain full carbonation and hydraulic strength.
